answer_1.quote: We present NL-EDIT, an edit-based model for interactive text-to-SQL with natural language feedback.

answer_2.quote: We follow (Elgohary et al., 2020) and use the correction accuracy as our main evaluation measure: each example in SPLASH test set contains an initial parse P ˜ and a gold parse P ˆ. With a predicted (corrected) parse by a correction model P ¯, they compute the correction accuracy using the exact-set-match between P ¯ and P ˆ averaged over all test examples.
